description: This resource represents a long-running operation that is the result of a network API call.

done.description: If the value is `false`, it means the operation is still in progress. If `true`, the operation is completed, and either `error` or `response` is available.

error.description: The error result of the operation in case of failure or cancellation.

metadata.description: Service-specific metadata associated with the operation. It typically contains progress information and common metadata such as create time. Some services might not provide such metadata. Any method that returns a long-running operation should document the metadata type, if any.

name.description: The server-assigned name, which is only unique within the same service that originally returns it. If you use the default HTTP mapping, the `name` should be a resource name ending with `operations/{unique_id}`.

response.description: The normal, successful response of the operation. If the original method returns no data on success, such as `Delete`, the response is `google.protobuf.Empty`. If the original method is standard `Get`/`Create`/`Update`, the response should be the resource. For other methods, the response should have the type `XxxResponse`, where `Xxx` is the original method name. For example, if the original method name is `TakeSnapshot()`, the inferred response type is `TakeSnapshotResponse`.

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the google.rpc.Status.details field, or localized by the client.

name: TargetTechnologyAlertDetail

description: Contains details for a technology watchlist finding.
name: TargetTechnologyFindingDetail

description: TechnologyWatchListAlertThreshold contains the thresholds for alerting.
name: TechnologyWatchListAlertThreshold

cvssScoreMinimum.description: Optional. The minimum CVSS score for the alert. Evaluates to CVSS v3 when available with a fallback to v2 and v4. Ex: 7.0. Valid range is [0.0, 10.0].

epssScoreMinimum.description: Optional. The minimum epss score for the alert. Ex: 0.8. Valid range is [0.0, 1.0].

exploitationStates.description: Optional. The exploitation states of the alert.

priorityMinimum.description: Optional. The minimum priority for the alert.

riskRatingMinimum.description: Optional. The minimum risk rating for the alert.

description: TechnologyWatchListConfig is the configuration for the technology watchlist.
name: TechnologyWatchListConfig

alertThreshold.description: Optional. Alert thresholds to effectively reduce noise.

technologies.description: Optional. List of vendor, technology or cpe fingerprint. example: Microsoft office 360 Apache Server 3.5 cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:outlook:*:*:*:*:*:*:*:*

description: Response message for UpsertConfiguration.
name: UpsertConfigurationResponse

configuration.description: Output only. Created configuration ID with server assigned id.

description: Contains details about a vulnerability match.
name: VulnerabilityMatch

associations.description: Optional. Associated threat actors, malware, etc. This is embedded as a snapshot because the details of the association at the time of the vulnerability match are important for context and reporting.

collectionId.description: Required. The collection ID of the vulnerability. Ex: "vulnerability--cve-2025-9876".

cveId.description: Required. The CVE ID of the vulnerability. Ex: "CVE-2025-9876". See https://www.cve.org/ for more information.

cvss3Score.description: Required. The CVSS score of the vulnerability. Evaluates to CVSS v3 when available with a fallback to v2 and v4. Example: 6.4.

description.description: Required. A description of the vulnerability.

disclosureTime.description: Optional. The disclosure time of the vulnerability.

epssScore.description: Optional. The EPSS score, representing the probability of exploitation. Example: 0.87.

exploitationConsequences.description: Optional. List of exploitation consequences for the vulnerability.

exploitationState.description: Required. The exploitation state of the vulnerability.

exploitationVectors.description: Optional. List of exploitation vectors for the vulnerability.

matchedTechnologies.description: Optional. The specific technologies from the configured watchlist that triggered the match. Ex: "Apache Struts".

priority.description: Optional. The priority level of the vulnerability data. Ex: "P1".

productFixes.description: Optional. List of product fixes for the vulnerability.

publiclyAvailableExploit.description: Output only. Whether a publicly available exploit exists.

riskRating.description: Required. The risk rating of the vulnerability.

technologies.description: Required. All technologies affected by the vulnerability. Ex: "Apache Struts".
